status: current Codex/OpenAI recommended defaults; review when provider docs or repo evals change

supervisor.escalation_triggers: Ambiguous architecture, unsafe merge risk, tricky firmware source review, or conflicting evidence.
supervisor.output_contract: Cycle report and final merge recommendation.
supervisor.tool_permission_posture: Orchestrates subagents and makes limited direct edits.

planner.escalation_triggers: Complex branch decomposition or source-authority ambiguity.
planner.output_contract: Ready batch with dependencies and stop rules.

architecture_specialist.escalation_triggers: Active firmware, runtime model, or source authority is involved.
architecture_specialist.deescalation_triggers: GPT-5.4 mini medium for simple docs/checker architecture.
architecture_specialist.output_contract: Architecture note with evidence and unknowns.

implementer.escalation_triggers: Firmware behavior risk or difficult compiler/generator logic is involved.

validator_reviewer.default_model: GPT-5.4 mini for docs/checker-only; GPT-5.5 for firmware source risk
validator_reviewer.default_reasoning_effort: medium for docs/checker-only; medium/high for firmware source risk
validator_reviewer.escalation_triggers: Active behavior, generated artifacts, or merge gate is involved.

docs_status_clerk.output_contract: Status doc delta and consistency checks.

judge_watchdog.escalation_triggers: Loop, unsafe path, or hardware gate appears.
judge_watchdog.deescalation_triggers: Branch is clearly done or blocked.
judge_watchdog.output_contract: DONE / CONTINUE / BLOCKED / NEEDS_HARDWARE / UNSAFE / LOOPING.
